description: Source code for the Twig Parser class, responsible for parsing Twig templates into an abstract syntax tree (AST).

classes.name: Twig	ext
classes.description: Parser class for processing Twig templates into an AST.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a token stream into a ModuleNode (AST).

methods.name: subparse
methods.description: Sub-parser method to process tokens until a condition is met.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the Environment object associated with the parser.

methods.name: getVarName
methods.description: Generates a unique internal variable name.

methods.name: getBlockStack
methods.description: Returns the current block stack (deprecated).

methods.name: peekBlockStack
methods.description: Returns the top block in the stack.

methods.name: popBlockStack
methods.description: Removes the top block from the stack.

methods.name: pushBlockStack
methods.description: Adds a block to the stack.

methods.name: hasBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block with a given name exists.

methods.name: getBlock
methods.description: Retrieves a block by name.

methods.name: setBlock
methods.description: Defines a new block.

methods.name: hasMacro
methods.description: Checks if a macro with a given name exists.

methods.name: setMacro
methods.description: Defines a new macro.

methods.name: addTrait
methods.description: Adds a trait to the parser.

methods.name: hasTraits
methods.description: Checks if traits are present.

methods.name: embedTemplate
methods.description: Embeds a template into the parser.

methods.name: addImportedSymbol
methods.description: Adds an imported symbol to the current scope.

methods.name: getImportedSymbol
methods.description: Retrieves an imported symbol by type and alias.

methods.name: isMainScope
methods.description: Checks if the parser is in the main scope.

methods.name: pushLocalScope
methods.description: Enters a new local scope.

methods.name: popLocalScope
methods.description: Exits the current local scope.

methods.name: getExpressionParser
methods.description: Returns the expression parser instance.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent node (deprecated).

methods.name: hasInheritance
methods.description: Checks if the template has inheritance or traits.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent node (template inheritance).

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns the current token stream.

methods.name: getCurrentToken
methods.description: Returns the current token.

methods.name: filterBodyNodes
methods.description: Filters and validates body nodes for template correctness.
